questions.question: What is the primary advantage of an Nmap TCP SYN scan (-sS)?
options: It establishes full 3-way handshakes to verify application response
It sends SYN packets and tears down connections with RST before completion, reducing log footprints
questions.explanation: SYN scanning (half-open) does not complete the 3-way handshake, making it stealthier than TCP connect scans.
